title: The Bus at Seven
text:
Mika takes the same bus every morning. She leaves her house at seven and walks to the stop near the shop. The walk is short, so she is never {{1}}.

Today the bus did not come at seven. Mika waited. Five minutes passed. Then ten. The air was {{2}}, and she put her hands in her pockets.

An old man at the stop looked at his watch. "The bus is slow today," he said. Mika smiled and said nothing. She was thinking about her first class.

At last the bus arrived. It was full, so Mika stood near the door. She was late, but only by ten minutes. Her teacher did not mind.

glossary.definition: a place where a bus waits for people
a small bag in your clothes for keys or hands

clozes.hint: she put her hands in her pockets because of this

questions.prompt: Why does Mika arrive at the stop on time on a normal day?
options: Her house is near the stop.
questions.rationale: The text says the walk is short, so she is never late.

questions.prompt: How long did Mika wait for the bus today?
questions.rationale: Five minutes passed, then ten, and she was late by ten minutes.
The last sentence says her teacher did not mind.

title: A Room with Two Windows
text:
Some rooms feel small. Some rooms feel big. The size of the room is only one reason.

Light is another reason. A room with two windows feels bigger than a room with one window. When the sun comes in, the walls look far away. When the room is dark, the walls look near.

Colour helps too. White walls make a room feel {{1}}. Dark walls make it feel small and {{2}}.

So if your room feels small, do not move. Open the curtains first. Then paint one wall white. The room will not change its size, but it will change how it feels.

glossary.definition: cloth that hangs over a window to stop the light
to put colour on a wall with a brush

clozes.hint: with a lot of open space and nothing in it

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of this text?
options: How a room feels does not depend only on its size.
Windows cost a lot of money.
White is the best colour for a house.
questions.rationale: The first paragraph says size is only one reason, and the rest gives other reasons.

questions.prompt: What does the writer tell you to do first?
questions.rationale: The last paragraph says to open the curtains first, then paint one wall.

questions.prompt: When do walls look far away?
questions.rationale: The text says when the sun comes in, the walls look far away.
